newsitem.title: GERMANY: British marketers award Audi brand of year prize.
newsitem.headline: British marketers award Audi brand of year prize.

text.p: German carmaker Audi AG said on Tuesday it had won an international marketing industry award for 1997 for its success in creating a distinctive corporate image.

Audi said the Marketing Society of Great Britain had recognised its worldwide boost in sales in the last two years as a marketing coup. The automaker's sales rose by almost 32 percent in 1996 to nearly 89,400 cars worldwide.

The jury of 3,000 marketing executives praised the company for coming out of its early 1990s slump and sharpening its vague product definition in the international market by redesigning its marketing, advertising and sponsoring strategy.
Bartle, Bogle, Hegarty (BBH) manages Audi's British advertising campaigns while the Hamburg-based Jung von Matt agency conducts its German account.
